## Drop the population data with NAs
```{r}

iris_with_population <- st_read("C:/Users/ohdaw/OneDrive/Documents/R_Projects/rental_desert/France/Updated_IRIS_with_Population.shp")

iris_with_population_and_rental <- iris_with_population %>%
```

## Sort the top 100 populated Urban Unit /IRIS
```{r}
# Convert 'P21_PMEN' to numeric, and handle any coercion warnings
iris_with_population_and_rental$P21_PMEN <- as.numeric(iris_with_population_and_rental$P21_PMEN)

# Sort the top 100 populated Urban Unit
# Group by Urban Unit and summarize the total P21_PMEN, then arrange and slice the top 100
top_100_urban_units <- iris_with_population_and_rental %>%
  group_by(UU2020) %>%
  summarize(total_population = sum(P21_PMEN, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_population)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100)
# View the result
print(top_100_urban_units)

# Sort the top 100 populated IRIS
# Group by IRIS and summarize the total P21_PMEN, then arrange and slice the top 100
top_100_IRIS <- iris_with_population_and_rental %>%
  group_by(CODE_IR) %>%
  summarize(total_population = sum(P21_PMEN, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_population)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100)
# View the result
print(top_100_IRIS)
```
```{r}
# Sort the dataset by P21_PMEN in descending order
sorted_urban_units <- iris_with_population_and_rental %>%

# Extract unique top 100 urban units, keeping all columns
top_100_urban_units_dataset <- sorted_urban_units %>%
  filter(!duplicated(uu2020)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100)
```

## Rental Desert IRISs for Top 100 Populated Urban Units
```{r}
# Convert the necessary columns in the dataset to numeric
top_100_urban_units_dataset <- top_100_urban_units_dataset %>%
  mutate(
    P21_RP = as.numeric(P21_RP),
    P21_NPER_RP = as.numeric(P21_NPER_RP),
    P21_RPMAISON = as.numeric(P21_RPMAISON),
    P21_RPAPPART = as.numeric(P21_RPAPPART),
    P21_LOGVAC = as.numeric(P21_LOGVAC)
  )

# Summarize main population and housing data by urban unit
urban_units_summary <- top_100_urban_units_dataset %>%
  summarise(
    total_main_residences = sum(P21_RP, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_population = sum(P21_NPER_RP, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_houses = sum(P21_RPMAISON, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_apartments = sum(P21_RPAPPART, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_vacant_dwellings = sum(P21_LOGVAC, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Convert necessary columns to numeric
top_100_urban_units_dataset <- top_100_urban_units_dataset %>%
  mutate(
    P21_RP_LOC = as.numeric(P21_RP_LOC),
    P21_RP = as.numeric(P21_RP)
  )

# Calculate rental metrics for urban units
urban_units_rental <- top_100_urban_units_dataset %>%
  mutate(
    rental_hu = P21_RP_LOC,
    tot_hsg_units = P21_RP,
    rental_sh = (rental_hu / tot_hsg_units) * 100,
    rental_des = ifelse(rental_sh < 20, 1, 0)
  )

# Check summary metrics for urban units
total_hsg_units_urban <- sum(urban_units_rental$tot_hsg_units, na.rm = TRUE)
rental_desert_share_urban <- prop.table(table(urban_units_rental$rental_des)) * 100

print(paste("Total Housing Units (Urban Units): ", total_hsg_units_urban))
rental_desert_share_deserts_urban <- rental_desert_share_urban["1"]
print(paste("Share of Rental Deserts (Urban Units) (%):", rental_desert_share_deserts_urban))
```

```{r}
# Identify IRIS within Top 100 Urban Units
top_100_urban_irs_ids <- top_100_urban_units_dataset$uu2020

# Filter IRIS from the entire dataset based on uu2020 from the top 100 urban units
iris_in_top_100_urban_units <- iris_with_population_and_rental %>%
  filter(uu2020 %in% top_100_urban_irs_ids)

# Calculate rental metrics for these filtered IRIS
iris_rental_deserts <- iris_in_top_100_urban_units %>%
  mutate(
    P21_RP_LOC = as.numeric(P21_RP_LOC),
    P21_RP     = as.numeric(P21_RP),
    rental_hu      = P21_RP_LOC,
    tot_hsg_units  = P21_RP,
    rental_sh      = (rental_hu / tot_hsg_units) * 100,
    rental_des     = ifelse(rental_sh < 20, 1, 0)
  )

# Calculate summary metrics
total_hsg_units_iris <- sum(iris_rental_deserts$tot_hsg_units, na.rm = TRUE)
rental_desert_share_iris <- prop.table(table(iris_rental_deserts$rental_des)) * 100

print(paste("Total Housing Units (IRIS in Top Urban Units): ", total_hsg_units_iris))
rental_desert_share_deserts_iris <- rental_desert_share_iris["1"]
print(paste("Share of Rental Deserts (IRIS in Top Urban Units) (%):", rental_desert_share_deserts_iris))
```


## Distribution of Rental Desert IRISs by Municipality Type for Top 100 Populated Urban Units
```{r}
# Convert all P21_ columns to numeric FIRST
iris_with_population_and_rental <- iris_with_population_and_rental %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("P21_"), as.numeric))

# Then create iris_in_top_100_urban_units
iris_in_top_100_urban_units <- iris_with_population_and_rental %>%
  filter(uu2020 %in% top_100_urban_units_dataset$uu2020) %>%
  mutate(
    rental_hu     = P21_RP_LOC,
    tot_hsg_units = P21_RP,
    rental_sh     = (rental_hu / tot_hsg_units) * 100,
    rental_des    = as.numeric(ifelse(rental_sh < 20, 1, 0))
  )

# Summary of all IRIS regions in top 100 urban units by municipality type
distribution_all_iris_municipalities <- iris_in_top_100_urban_units %>%
  filter(!is.na(rental_des)) %>%
  mutate(IRIS_count = 1) %>%
  group_by(mncplt_) %>%
  summarise(total_iris = sum(IRIS_count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(share = total_iris / sum(total_iris, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) %>%
  filter(total_iris > 0)
print(distribution_all_iris_municipalities)

# Distribution of rental deserts by municipality type in top 100 IRIS
distribution_rental_deserts <- iris_in_top_100_urban_units %>%
  filter(rental_des == 1) %>%
  group_by(mncplt_) %>%
  summarise(total_rental_deserts = sum(rental_des, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(share = total_rental_deserts / sum(total_rental_deserts, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) %>%
  filter(total_rental_deserts > 0)
print(distribution_rental_deserts)
```

## average share of single/multi -family homes Across the IRISs Included in The Top 100 Populated Urban Units
```{r}
# Create a neighborhood category based on rental share
iris_with_income <- iris_with_income %>%
  mutate(rd_nbrhd_cat = case_when(
    rental_sh < 20 ~ "1 RentalDesert",
    rental_sh >= 20 & rental_sh < 80 ~ "2 MixedTenure",
    rental_sh >= 80 ~ "3 HighRental"
  ))

# Calculate and summarize the average share of single-family homes by neighborhood category
avg_sfsh_by_category <- iris_with_income %>%
  filter(!is.na(rd_nbrhd_cat)) %>%
  group_by(rd_nbrhd_cat) %>%
  summarise(avg_sfsh = mean(P21_MAISON / P21_LOG * 100, na.rm = TRUE))

print(avg_sfsh_by_category)

# Calculate and summarize the average share of multi-family housing by neighborhood category
avg_mf_by_category <- iris_with_income %>%
  filter(!is.na(rd_nbrhd_cat)) %>%
  group_by(rd_nbrhd_cat) %>%
  summarise(avg_mf_5pl = mean(P21_APPART / P21_LOG * 100, na.rm = TRUE))

print(avg_mf_by_category)
```


## Average Income Across the IRISs Included in The Top 100 Populated Urban Units
```{r}
# Calculate average median incomes by rental category
iris_with_income %>%
  filter(!is.na(rental_sh) & !is.na(DEC_MED21)) %>% 
  mutate(rd_nbrhd_cat = case_when(
    rental_sh < 20 ~ "1 RentalDesert",
    rental_sh >= 20 & rental_sh < 80 ~ "2 MixedTenure",
    rental_sh >= 80 ~ "3 HighRental"
  )) %>% 
  group_by(rd_nbrhd_cat) %>% 
  summarise(avg_income = mean(DEC_MED21, na.rm = TRUE))
```


## Income Distributions Across the IRISs Included in The Top 100 Populated Urban Units
```{r}
# Categorize IRIS based on median income and rental share, and calculate shares
income_shares_iris <- iris_with_income %>%
  filter(!is.na(rental_sh) & !is.na(DEC_MED21)) %>%
  mutate(
    rd_nbrhd_cat = case_when(
      rental_sh < 20 ~ "Rental Deserts",
      rental_sh >= 20 & rental_sh < 80 ~ "Mixed-Tenure Neighborhoods",
      rental_sh >= 80 ~ "High-Rental Neighborhoods"
    ),
    low_income_flag = if_else(DEC_MED21 < 20000, 1, 0),
    middle_income_flag = if_else(DEC_MED21 >= 20000 & DEC_MED21 <= 40000, 1, 0),
    high_income_flag = if_else(DEC_MED21 > 40000, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(rd_nbrhd_cat) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_lish = mean(low_income_flag, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    avg_mish = mean(middle_income_flag, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    avg_hish = mean(high_income_flag, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("avg_"), names_to = "Income Level", values_to = "Share") %>%
  mutate(`Income Level` = recode(`Income Level`,
                                 "avg_lish" = "Low Income",
                                 "avg_mish" = "Middle Income",
                                 "avg_hish" = "High Income"))

# Optionally, save the resulting dataset to a CSV
write.csv(iris_with_income, "/Users/ohdaw/OneDrive/Documents/R_Projects/rental_desert/France/Updated_IRIS_with_Income.csv")
```

```{r}
# Plotting
ggplot(income_shares_iris, aes(x = `Income Level`, y = Share, fill = rd_nbrhd_cat)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Average Share by Income Level and Neighborhood Type",
       x = "Household Income",
       y = "Average Share (Percent)",
       fill = "Neighborhood Type") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#e5c3c6", "#b089bc", "#4d004b")) +
  theme_minimal()
```

##Static Map of Reental Desert Distribution
```{r}
# Load the shapefile containing IRIS data with France boundaries
iris_with_population <- st_read("C:/Users/ohdaw/OneDrive/Documents/R_Projects/rental_desert/France/Updated_IRIS_with_Population.shp")

# Prepare the rental category data
selected_rental_data <- iris_with_income %>%
  filter(!is.na(rental_sh)) %>%
  mutate(
    rd_nbrhd_cat = case_when(
      rental_sh < 20 ~ "Rental Desert",     # Focus only on rental deserts
      rental_sh >= 20 & rental_sh < 80 ~ "Mixed-Tenure",
      rental_sh >= 80 ~ "High-Rental"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(IRIS, rd_nbrhd_cat)

# Merge with spatial data
map_data <- iris_with_population %>%
  left_join(selected_rental_data, by = c("CODE_IR" = "IRIS"))

# Keep only the rental desert categories for specific coloring
rental_desert_data <- map_data %>% filter(rd_nbrhd_cat == "Rental Desert")

# Plot the map with ggplot2 - entire boundary colored lightly, focus on rental deserts
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = iris_with_population, fill = "gray", color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +  # Base map for France, shaded lightly
  geom_sf(data = rental_desert_data, aes(fill = rd_nbrhd_cat), color = "#e34a33") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Rental Desert" = "#e34a33")) +  # Color specific to rental deserts
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "IRIS Rental Deserts in France", fill = "Rental Category")
```


##Interactive Map of Rental Desert Distribution
```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Load the shapefile (assuming it's in a file named 'iris_shapefile.shp')
iris_with_population <- st_read("C:/Users/ohdaw/OneDrive/Documents/R_Projects/rental_desert/France/Updated_IRIS_with_Population.shp")

# Load rental and income data
france_rental <- read_csv("C:/Users/ohdaw/OneDrive/Documents/R_Projects/rental_desert/France/france_rental.csv")
income_data   <- read_csv("C:/Users/ohdaw/OneDrive/Documents/R_Projects/rental_desert/France/Updated_IRIS_with_Income.csv")

# Join to create france_rental_with_income
france_rental_with_income <- france_rental %>%
  left_join(
    income_data %>% select(codgeo, DEC_MED21),  # only bring in the income column
    by = c("IRIS" = "codgeo")
  )

iris_shapefile_poly <- st_read("C:/Users/ohdaw/OneDrive/Documents/R_Projects/rental_desert/France/Updated_Combined_Data.shp") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

# Select necessary columns and perform the join
selected_rental_data <- france_rental_with_income %>%
  filter(!is.na(rental_sh)) %>%
  mutate(
    rd_nbrhd_cat = case_when(
      rental_sh < 20                    ~ "Rental Desert",
      rental_sh >= 20 & rental_sh < 80  ~ "Mixed-Tenure",
      rental_sh >= 80                   ~ "High-Rental"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(IRIS, rd_nbrhd_cat)

# Convert CRS to WGS 84
iris_shapefile_poly <- st_transform(iris_shapefile_poly, crs = 4326)

# Merge with spatial data
map_data <- iris_with_population %>%
  left_join(selected_rental_data, by = c("CODE_IR" = "IRIS"))

# Ensure no NAs in key columns for plotting
map_data <- map_data %>% filter(!is.na(rd_nbrhd_cat))

# Filter IRIS codes that belong to top 100 populated urban units
iris_in_top_100_urban_units <- iris_with_population_and_rental %>%
  filter(uu2020 %in% top_100_urban_units_dataset$uu2020) %>%
  pull(CODE_IR)

# Merge with selected rental data for desired IRIS
map_data_poly <- iris_shapefile_poly %>%
  filter(CODE_IR %in% iris_in_top_100_urban_units) %>%
  left_join(selected_rental_data, by = c("CODE_IR" = "IRIS")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rd_nbrhd_cat))

# Create the interactive map
leaflet(map_data_poly) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~ifelse(rd_nbrhd_cat == "Rental Desert", "red",
                        ifelse(rd_nbrhd_cat == "Mixed-Tenure", "blue", "green")),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = "white",
    weight = 0.5,
    label = ~paste("Category:", rd_nbrhd_cat)
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    "bottomright",
    colors = c("red", "blue", "green"),
    labels = c("Rental Desert", "Mixed-Tenure", "High-Rental"),
    title = "Neighborhood Type"
  )
```

```{r}
## Assume your data preparation steps are complete, and 'map_data' is ready

# Loop over top metros to create static maps
for (metro_name in top_100_urban_units_dataset$libgeo) {
  metro_data <- map_data_poly %>%
    filter(libgeo == metro_name)    # ✅ libgeo not libgeo.x
  
  if (nrow(metro_data) == 0) {
    message("No data for: ", metro_name)
    next
  }
  
  map_plot <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = metro_data, aes(fill = rd_nbrhd_cat), color = "black", size = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Rental Desert" = "red", 
                                 "Mixed-Tenure"  = "blue", 
                                 "High-Rental"   = "green")) +
    labs(title = paste("IRIS Map for", metro_name), fill = "Neighborhood Type") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  
  print(map_plot)
  # ggsave(filename = paste0("IRIS_Map_", metro_name, ".png"), plot = map_plot, width = 8, height = 6)
}
```
